title: Chinese New Years Lanterns
body:
**Chinese New Years Lanterns as the title already suggests changes the lantern models and textures to look like the new years lanterns famous in China.**

This, just like the Japanese Lanterns is another pack that I originally made years ago and finally decided to completely remake again to bring it up to my modern standards. Seems like I happened to get to it just in time for Chinese New Year. Anyways have fun with this one!

**This pack also supports the following Mods:**
- [Jaden's Nether Expansion](https://modrinth.com/mod/jadens-nether-expansion)
- [The Endergetic Expansion](https://modrinth.com/mod/endergetic)
- [Caverns and Chasms](https://modrinth.com/mod/caverns-and-chasms)
